item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00385","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C01","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child. Both are presidential letters ordering an agency study of the deeper domestic problems of a particular industry while a related, more immediate governmental review is underway. Each directs the study to examine improvements the industry itself can make, reconcile industry support with foreign-trade objectives, produce recommendations, meet a deadline keyed to another policy process, and notes an attached companion letter. C01 strongly informs the child's foreign-trade policy rationale and identifies the proposed commission that would receive the wool study, but it is less similar as an agency-study drafting template. C03 closely parallels the conflict between import restrictions and freer trade but lacks the child's industry-specific study machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"this investigation by the Tariff Commission be supplemented by a broader study of the domestic factors which have contributed to the decline in sheep numbers and wool production","parent_excerpt":"I should like to have the Department of Commerce undertake a study to determine whether the complete elimination of present tax benefits would require any increase in direct subsidy for this industry.","explanation":"Both supplement a related governmental inquiry with an agency study addressing the underlying condition and appropriate support of a specific domestic industry."},{"child_excerpt":"set forth constructive suggestions which will promote the development of a sound and prosperous domestic wool industry and at the same time permit an expanding foreign trade","parent_excerpt":"your study should take full account of whatever opportunities may exist for the industry itself to increase its operating efficiency and generally to improve its financial position. If changes in present Federal policies are needed... please include appropriate recommendations","explanation":"Both require constructive recommendations combining industry self-improvement with reconsideration of federal policy, rather than relying solely on protective measures."},{"child_excerpt":"In order that this study may be of value with respect to the present situation, I request that the findings be available... by the time the Tariff Commission makes its report","parent_excerpt":"In order that these studies may provide the basis for prompt legislative recommendations to the new Congress, I am requesting that they be submitted to me by October 15, 1952.","explanation":"The child closely follows the functional sequence of explaining why timely completion matters and setting a deadline tied to a parallel policy process."},{"child_excerpt":"A copy of my letter to the Chairman of the Tariff Commission requesting an investigation... is attached.","parent_excerpt":"I am attaching for your information a copy of the letter which I am sending at this time to the Secretary of the Treasury.","explanation":"Both close by attaching a companion letter concerning the coordinated parallel inquiry."}]}
